messages.author: 1e6974b6056c692a
messages.subject: exclude some R source code from showcase
parts:
[posting here as per suggestion from shinyapps users group]

Hi,
Is there any way to exclude some file from being displayed in showcase mode?
Actually I'd like to show ui.R and server.R only.

Thanks,
Hernán.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: exclude some R source code from showcase
parts:
I don't think there's a way to disable it directly, but you could have your server.R simply call:
  source("otherfile.R", local=TRUE)

where all your server code is in otherfile.R.
